findings.title: Promotion check uses wrong base
findings.reason: Verified against the diff. Line 39-40 resumes the park on 'leg N's head is an ancestor of the integration BASE (git merge-base --is-ancestor <head> origin/<base>)'. Leg N's own unit PRs merge into that same BASE during the leg, so the ancestry test is already satisfied before the chain reaches the park — it cannot witness the owed promotion. The repo's own exemplar confirms the real gate is BASE-to-default: docs/reports/chaining-2026-09-16/handoff-log.md G-PROMO-1 records 'leg-1 BASE chain417/leg1-cleansweep-base @ c5e807c -> scratch main promotion owed', citing the gate-classification registry entry 'merge to default'. Secondary point also holds: origin/<base> cannot resolve for the no-remote lane that line 37 names as this park's expected origin, and that is the very lane #444 addresses in this same PR. Internal contradiction between the new resume fact and both the exemplar and the sibling clause.
